bad_folder: Invalid folder name: use letters, numbers, dot, hyphen or _ (no / or space).
bad_order: Send the list of ids in the desired order.
bad_path: Enter the absolute folder path (starts with /).
deny_contains_netops: This folder contains NetOps. Choose a folder that does not include the NetOps installation.
deny_hidden: Hidden folders of the server user (~/.claude, ~/.ssh...) cannot be a project.
deny_home: The home folder of the server user cannot be a project. Use a subfolder.
deny_netops: The NetOps folder (and what is inside it) belongs to the Claude Code tab. Choose another folder.
deny_system: A system folder cannot be a project. Use a subfolder of your own (e.g. {example}).
duplicate_path: This folder is already the project “{name}”.
exists: Something with this name already exists in this folder. Use “Existing folder”.
no_access: The server is not allowed to read this folder.
not_a_dir: The path is not a folder.
path_not_found: This folder does not exist on the server.
